name: web-search
title: Web search (4 backends)
description: Search the web across DuckDuckGo, Tavily, Firecrawl, and Serper. Each backend becomes its own tool the agent can call. Ships a fat SKILL.md teaching the model when to use which backend, query craft, and result narration rules.

envVars.name: TAVILY_API_KEY
envVars.help: Tavily Search API key. Free tier ~1000 q/month. Sign up: https://tavily.com

envVars.name: FIRECRAWL_API_KEY
envVars.help: Firecrawl API key. Free tier available. Sign up: https://firecrawl.dev

envVars.name: SERPER_API_KEY
envVars.help: Serper API key (Google index, no Cloud Console setup). 2500 free queries on signup at https://serper.dev

resolverRow.trigger: search the web, look up, what is the latest
